name: kemenag-monorepo
description: Website resmi Kementerian Agama Kabupaten Barito Utara — Monorepo (Astro + Go Fiber)

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-workspaces && npm --prefix frontend install && go -C backend mod download
scripts.dev: infisical run --env=dev --path=/website-kemenag -- concurrently -k -n FE,BE -c cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "go -C backend run github.com/air-verse/air@latest -c .air.toml"
scripts.dev:prod: infisical run --env=prod --path=/website-kemenag -- concurrently -k -n FE,BE -c cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "go -C backend run github.com/air-verse/air@latest -c .air.toml"
scripts.dev:fe: infisical run --env=dev --path=/website-kemenag -- npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:fe:prod: infisical run --env=prod --path=/website-kemenag -- npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:be: infisical run --env=dev --path=/website-kemenag -- go -C backend run github.com/air-verse/air@latest -c .air.toml
scripts.dev:be:prod: infisical run --env=prod --path=/website-kemenag -- go -C backend run github.com/air-verse/air@latest -c .air.toml
scripts.build: npm run build:fe && npm run build:be
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FE,BE -c cyan,green "npm run start:fe" "npm run start:be"
scripts.test: infisical run --env=dev --path=/website-kemenag -- concurrently -n FE,BE "npm --prefix frontend run test" "go -C backend test ./..."
